# ethereum-optimism/infra Weekly Report (Mar 22 - 28, 2026)

## 🚀 Highlights
This week focused on significant infrastructure hardening and the stabilization of the testing pipeline. The team executed a major upgrade to **Go 1.26** across most modules and migrated to **Docker Hardened Images (DHI)** to minimize the project's attack surface. Efforts to improve developer experience were bolstered by more accurate CI/CD reporting for flaky tests and the resolution of several long-standing acceptance test failures. Additionally, progress continued on Interop Phase 3 and Custom Gas Token (CGT) integration, ensuring the infrastructure remains robust as the Superchain ecosystem expands.

## 🛠️ Key Developments

### Infrastructure Hardening & Dependency Management
The project underwent a significant security and performance overhaul by upgrading the core runtime environment.
*   **Go 1.26 Migration:** Most modules were bumped from various end-of-life versions (1.21–1.24) to Go 1.26, ensuring access to the latest performance optimizations and security patches ([#579](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/579)).
*   **Docker Hardened Images (DHI):** All Dockerfiles were migrated to hardened base images. This included stripping unused runtime dependencies like `jq`, `curl`, and `git` from `proxyd`, `op-ufm`, and `peer-mgmt-service` to reduce potential attack vectors ([#579](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/579), [#580](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/580)).

### CI/CD & Test Observability
Improvements were made to how the team tracks and manages non-deterministic test results.
*   **Flaky Test Reporting:** The `cci-stats` service was updated to better handle flaky test markers. A fix was implemented to use `Contains` instead of `HasPrefix` when scanning log messages, ensuring that `FLAKY_PASS` and `FLAKY_FAIL` statuses are correctly captured and reported rather than filtered out ([#576](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/576), [#578](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/578)).

### Protocol & Tooling Enhancements
*   **Kona Guest Fix:** Resolved a critical panic in the Kona guest program occurring during Cannon VM execution. The fix addressed a deserialization error in `chainList.json` caused by a missing `name` field ([#19654](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19654)).
*   **Kona-Interop Testing:** Developed a fixture-based integration test for the block hash oracle using real OP Mainnet state trie proofs. This provides a high-fidelity, fast-running alternative to impractical long-running acceptance tests ([#18288](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/18288)).

## 🐛 Issues & Triage

### Closed Issues
The team successfully cleared several flaky tests that had shown consistent stability over dozens of consecutive runs:
*   **Acceptance Tests:** `TestChallengerPlaysGame` ([#19672](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19672)), `TestUnsafeChainNotStalling_ELSync` ([#19611](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19611)), and `TestSuperchain` ([#19586](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19586)).
*   **Interop & Sync:** `TestSupernodeSameTimestampInvalidTransitive` ([#19570](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19570)) and `TestSyncUnsafe` ([#19731](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19731)).

### New & Active Issues
*   **Proxyd Security:** A new issue was opened regarding the lack of TLS support for WebSocket upstreams in `proxyd`. Currently, client certificates only apply to HTTP, leaving a gap in backend security ([#577](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/577)).
*   **Interop Phase 3:** Discussions are ongoing regarding the removal of chains from shared dispute games within the proofs system ([#19692](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19692)).
*   **Custom Gas Tokens (CGT):** Technical debt was identified regarding the overlap between CGT and `ETHLiquidity` contracts, which may require workarounds for predeploys in the interop fork ([#19711](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19711), [#19461](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19461)).
*   **Persistent Flakiness:** `TestCLELDivergence` ([#19681](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19681)) remains under investigation. While a potential fix is being tested, the team is debating whether observed "resets" are bugs or expected behavior during the initial derivation pipeline lifecycle.

## 💬 Community & Collaboration
The week saw active engagement from the community regarding developer tooling. A new initiative offering free **Base L2 developer APIs** for testing garnered early feedback and contributions, including AI agent strategies shared by community members ([#19718](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19718)). Internal collaboration was high across the `op-reth` and `kona` workstreams, specifically in aligning interop transaction pool features with upstream `reth` requirements.
